summary.text: Cecelia González is a Democratic Nevada Assembly member from District 16 who has served since November 2020 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An educator, she is vice chair of the Legislative Operations and Elections Committee.

paragraphs.text: González was born in Whittier, California, and graduated from Canyon Springs High School in 2010.
She earned a B.A. in criminal justice in 2015 and an M.Ed. in multicultural education in 2019, both from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas.
Her career experience includes working as an educator.
González assumed office on November 4, 2020, succeeding Heidi Swank.
For 2025 and 2026 she was assigned to the Health and Human Services, Judiciary, and Legislative Operations and Elections committees, serving as vice chair of the last.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
